   **Баги и стабильность.**
      20 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 8 июн. 2026 г. - 26 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _lil pxng_, 26 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Tried to install this, used it, got past the setup and it crashes and freezes and doesn’t let it work at all, I can’t even get past setup"
            2. _missamyw_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Ever since the big UI change a few months ago, there have been so many bugs. Sure, it was kind of annoying having to figure out where everything moved to and what order things were in with the new UI. But it happens, just need time to get used to it. But the constant bugs have led to me switching off the rules more often than not. Used to be really a really great way to keep my phone usage down with minimal friction, but now is just a pest of an app. Not renewing my annual subscription."
            3. _🤫😭😉😘_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Bro this app was one of the only apps that worked for me and I recently deleted it because it was buggy. When I try to redownload it I can’t get past the part where I select rules for managing an app or a section for screen time. It just freezes up and goes completely black"
